#function tạo table summary demographic, gender, doi , serotype, age , province  

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(gtsummary)
library(flextable)
library(officer)

# Hàm chuẩn bị dữ liệu và tạo bảng
create_demo_table <- function(dataset) {

  demo_data <- dataset %>%
    transmute(
      gender = factor(
        gender,
        levels = c("male", "female"),
        labels = c("Male", "Female")
      ),
       age = as.numeric(age),
      province = factor(province),
      serotype = factor(
        serotype,
        levels = c("D1", "D2", "D3", "D4"),
        labels = c("DENV-1", "DENV-2", "DENV-3", "DENV-4")
      ),
      #DOI = as.numeric(DOI)
      DOI = factor(
        DOI,
        levels = sort(unique(na.omit(DOI)))
      )
    )

  demo_data %>%
    tbl_summary(
      type = list(
        all_continuous() ~ "continuous",
        all_categorical() ~ "categorical"
      ),
      statistic = list(
        all_continuous() ~ "{median} ({p25}–{p75})",
        all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
      ),
      digits = list(
        all_continuous() ~ 1,
        all_categorical() ~ c(0, 1)
      ),
      label = list(
        gender ~ "Gender",
        age ~ "Age",
        province ~ "Province",
        serotype ~ "Serotype",
        DOI ~ "Day of illness"
      ),
      missing = "ifany",
      missing_text = "NA"
    ) %>%
    modify_header(
      label ~ "**Characteristic**",
      stat_0 ~ "**Overall (N = {N})**"
    ) %>%
    bold_labels()
}

#2. Tạo bảng cho cả 3 dataset
tbl1 <- create_demo_table(dataset1) 
tbl2 <- create_demo_table(dataset2)
tbl3 <- create_demo_table(dataset3)

#3. Ghép thành một bảng để so sánh
tbl_all <- tbl_merge(
  tbls = list(tbl1, tbl2, tbl3),
  tab_spanner = c(
    "**Dataset 1**",
    "**Dataset 2**",
    "**Dataset 3**"
  )
)

tbl_all

as_flex_table(tbl_all) %>%
  save_as_docx(
    path = "result/Table1_Demographic_3_Datasets.docx"
  )

# Lưu bảng Dataset 1
as_flex_table(tbl1) %>%
  save_as_docx(path = "result/Table1_Demographic_Dataset1.docx")

# Lưu bảng Dataset 2
as_flex_table(tbl2) %>%
  save_as_docx(path = "result/Table2_Demographic_Dataset2.docx")

# Lưu bảng Dataset 3
as_flex_table(tbl3) %>%
  save_as_docx(path = "result/Table3_Demographic_Dataset3.docx")
```


#------ 
code không dung tbl summary 
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(openxlsx)

# 1. Chuẩn bị dữ liệu
demo_data <- dataset1 %>%
  transmute(
    gender = trimws(as.character(gender)),
    age = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(age_adjust)),
    province = trimws(as.character(province)),
    serotype = trimws(as.character(kq_dinh_typ_dengue)),
    DOI = as.numeric(date_of_illness)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(gender, province, serotype),
      ~ na_if(.x, "")
    ),
    gender = case_when(
      tolower(gender) == "male" ~ "Male",
      tolower(gender) == "female" ~ "Female",
      TRUE ~ gender
    )
  )

# Tổng số mẫu
N <- nrow(demo_data)
# 2. Hàm tạo bảng n (%)
categorical_table <- function(data, variable, label) {

  x <- data[[variable]]
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & trimws(x) != ""]

  counts <- sort(table(x), decreasing = TRUE)

  result <- data.frame(
    Characteristic = paste0("   ", names(counts)),
    Overall = sprintf(
      "%d (%.1f%%)",
      as.integer(counts),
      100 * as.numeric(counts) / length(x)
    )
  )

  missing_n <- sum(is.na(data[[variable]]) |
                     trimws(ifelse(is.na(data[[variable]]),
                                   "", data[[variable]])) == "")

  bind_rows(
    data.frame(
      Characteristic = label,
      Overall = ""
    ),
    result,
    data.frame(
      Characteristic = "   Missing, n",
      Overall = as.character(missing_n)
    )
  )
}

# 3. Hàm tạo bảng median (IQR)
continuous_table <- function(data, variable, label) {

  x <- data[[variable]]
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]

  summary_value <- if (length(x) > 0) {
    q <- quantile(x, c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75), na.rm = TRUE)
    sprintf("%.1f (%.1f–%.1f)", q[2], q[1], q[3])
  } else {
    "NA"
  }

  missing_n <- sum(!is.finite(data[[variable]]))

  bind_rows(
    data.frame(
      Characteristic = label,
      Overall = ""
    ),
    data.frame(
      Characteristic = "   Median (IQR)",
      Overall = summary_value
    ),
    data.frame(
      Characteristic = "   Missing, n",
      Overall = as.character(missing_n)
    )
  )
}

# 4. Tạo Table 1
table1 <- bind_rows(

  data.frame(
    Characteristic = "Study population",
    Overall = as.character(N)
  ),

  categorical_table(
    demo_data, "gender", "Sex, n (%)"
  ),

  continuous_table(
    demo_data, "age", "Age, years"
  ),

  categorical_table(
    demo_data, "province", "Province, n (%)"
  ),

  categorical_table(
    demo_data, "serotype", "Dengue virus serotype, n (%)"
  ),

  continuous_table(
    demo_data, "DOI", "Day of illness at sample collection"
  )
)

# 5. Xuất Excel
wb <- createWorkbook()

addWorksheet(wb, "Table 1")

writeData(
  wb,
  "Table 1",
  "Table 1. Demographic and clinical characteristics",
  startRow = 1,
  startCol = 1
)

writeData(
  wb,
  "Table 1",
  table1,
  startRow = 3,
  startCol = 1
)

# Định dạng tiêu đề
title_style <- createStyle(
  textDecoration = "bold",
  fontSize = 14
)

header_style <- createStyle(
  textDecoration = "bold",
  fgFill = "#D9EAF7",
  border = "Bottom"
)

section_style <- createStyle(
  textDecoration = "bold"
)

addStyle(wb, "Table 1", title_style,
         rows = 1, cols = 1:2)

addStyle(wb, "Table 1", header_style,
         rows = 3, cols = 1:2,
         gridExpand = TRUE)

# In đậm các dòng tiêu đề nhóm
section_rows <- which(
  table1$Overall == "" |
    table1$Characteristic == "Study population"
) + 3

addStyle(
  wb, "Table 1",
  section_style,
  rows = section_rows,
  cols = 1:2,
  gridExpand = TRUE,
  stack = TRUE
)

setColWidths(wb, "Table 1", cols = 1, widths = 42)
setColWidths(wb, "Table 1", cols = 2, widths = 22)
freezePane(wb, "Table 1", firstActiveRow = 4)

saveWorkbook(
  wb,
  "data/Table1_Demographic.xlsx",
  overwrite = TRUE
)
```

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(gtsummary)
library(flextable)
library(officer)

# 1. Chuẩn bị dữ liệu
demo_data <- dataset1 %>%
  transmute(
    gender = factor(gender),
    age = as.numeric(age_adjust),
    province = factor(province),
    serotype = factor(kq_dinh_typ_dengue),
    DOI = as.numeric(date_of_illness)
  ) |> mutate(
    serotype = factor(
      serotype,
      levels = c("D1", "D2", "D3", "D4"),
      labels = c("DENV-1", "DENV-2", "DENV-3", "DENV-4")
    ))  |> mutate(
    gender = factor(
      gender,
      levels = c("male", "female"),
      labels = c("Male", "Female")
    )) 


# 2. Tạo bảng demographic
tbl_demo <- demo_data %>%
  tbl_summary(
    type = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "continuous",
      all_categorical() ~ "categorical"
    ),
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{median} ({p25}–{p75})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
    ),
    digits = list(
      all_continuous() ~ 1,
      all_categorical() ~ c(0, 1)
    ),
    label = list(
      gender ~ "Gender",
      age ~ "Age (years)",
      province ~ "Province",
      serotype ~ "Dengue virus serotype",
      DOI ~ "Day of illness at sample collection"
    ),
    missing = "ifany",
    missing_text = "NA"
  ) %>%
  modify_header(
    label ~ "**Characteristic**",
    stat_0 ~ "**Overall (N = {N})**"
  ) %>%
  bold_labels()

# 3. Hiển thị bảng
tbl_demo
```
